title: Nothing Else Wins
setup: Black's king has just stepped across to f8, straight in front of the pawn, and White must choose.
hint: Five of White's six moves throw the point away; ask which one takes squares off the black king.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{f7}} looks like it walls the pawn in, but it covers e8 and g8, so {{Ke7}} is forced and {{Kg7}} walks the pawn home. Any king move instead lets Black's king keep its place in front of the pawn, and then the ending is a dead draw.
